question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic tangent function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{artanh}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{1}{3}\operatorname{artanh}⁡(3x-1)) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{artanh}⁡(3x-1)) \\  & =\frac{1}{3}\cdot \frac{1}{1-{(3x-1)}^{2}}\cdot {(3x-1)}^{′} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}\cdot \frac{1}{1-(9{x}^{2}-6x+1)}\cdot 3 \\  & =\frac{3}{3}\cdot \frac{1}{6x-9{x}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{1}{3x(2-3x)}.\end{aligned}
$$
